text:
Ava (Content): Putting the near-final blog draft here: https://docs.internal/launch/launch-blog-v3. Need legal + product signoff before I send to publishing at 5pm PT. Also confirm CTA & demo routing.
Sam (Growth): Quick one 1 1 1 1 what's the exact wording of the hero benchmark? The draft says '35% latency improvement across workloads' 1 need the source for SEO and tweet.
Leo (Product): That was from our 8k token internal suite vs previous gen. It's median latency across our microbench scenarios. I can paste the test summary in a sec.
Priya (Design): Heads up: hero mock needs bleed fixed for mobile. I can export both 1200x628 and a taller 900x600 alt. Which one should go to the preview?
Ava (Content): Put both. We'll let the CMS pick the responsive variant.
Maya (Legal): Skimming the copy: recommend conservative phrasing. Replace "35% latency improvement across workloads" with "up to 35% lower median latency" and add parenthetical "(internal benchmark, 8k tokens, median)". Also flag the performance callout in the social blurb 1 be careful with absolutes.
Sam (Growth): Works for me if we keep the number. For A/B we can test 'up to 35% faster' vs '35% lower latency' on the landing CTR.
Omar (Ops): Webinar vendor check: Stream host can support 500 concurrent viewers, breakout demo rooms are limited to 4 rooms at 30 seats each. If we add a repeat we'll need a second host slot. Ops cost +1.
Nora (CM): HubSpot flows ready. Proposed CTAs:
```
A) Save your seat 1 Live demo + Q&A
B) Register for launch webinar
C) Request a dedicated demo (sales follow-up)
```
Ava (Content): I'm leaning A for social and blog hero. Map C to the demo flow so ops can route leads to demo ops.
Leo (Product): Product signoff contingent on legal-approved phrasing. Also remove the competitor comparison line on para 3.
Maya (Legal): Agree. Competitor references removed. Approve with the "up to" language and exact parenthetical.
Sam (Growth): UTM suggestion: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_term=herocta. Nora ok?
Nora (CM): Confirmed. We'll tag CTA variants in HubSpot: hero=A, in-body=B, demo=C. Demo leads go to automation flow 'launch-demo-2026'.
Priya (Design): Exports uploaded to the assets folder: /assets/launch/hero-1200x628.png and hero-900x600.png.
publish-bot: Preview available: https://preview.redwood.com/preview/launch-blog/4477771234 1 scheduled window: 2026-03-25T00:00:00Z (manual publish).
Ava (Content): Final checklist: hero claim phrasing (legal ok), hero image (uploaded), CTAs mapped (nora ok), demo ops capacity (omar flagged repeat cost). Can everyone drop a one-word ack? Locking in 15m.
Leo (Product): LGTM
Maya (Legal): Legal OK
Sam (Growth): Good
Priya (Design): Done
Omar (Ops): Ops confirmed for single run + 4 demo rooms, repeat pending cost sign-off
Nora (CM): HubSpot & UTMs set
Ava (Content): Thanks team 1 moving to publish queue.
